verdict: Organic presence holds; overdue pipeline work is the priority this week.
narrative: Across all three entities this period, every engagement came through Google Business Profile — combined, your profiles logged 431 total actions (directions, website clicks, and calls) over 28 days with zero paid spend active on any channel. GBP momentum is mixed: Advance Grinding Services is up 15% week over week, while Forte Precision Metals is down 19% and O'Hare Precision Metals is down 23%, with the sharpest drop recorded in the final two days of the window. The more pressing issue is upstream: a set of CRM and outreach milestones that were due in August and September remain unresolved, which means the automation and cold-email pipeline that feeds leads into the business is effectively paused. Those blockers — stub account reconciliation, the data parser fix, contact pulls, and lapsed outreach sequences — are being worked through now, and the goal is to have them cleared by October 31 so the next reporting period shows pipeline activity alongside organic engagement.

watch_item.issue: Eight milestones covering CRM stub reconciliation, the data parser, contact pulls, and outreach sequences are overdue, blocking the automated lead pipeline entirely.
watch_item.fix: All eight items are targeted for resolution by October 31; once cleared, automated outreach and CRM sync will resume and pipeline activity should appear in the next report.
